summary: A single illustrated object centred on a flat near-white (#f6f6f9) canvas with a small grey home-indicator pill at bottom centre (954-1006, 1060-1070): a paper-towel/receipt roll drawn in thick royal-blue (#2826c8) outline, with a 3D box bracket on its left (672-748, 412-556) and a small tab on its right (1272-1288, 450-526). The roll's top is a cylinder (thick curved side strokes down to ~y 640) and below it straight paper hangs to a zig-zag torn bottom edge. On the paper sit list rows separated by lavender dashed lines: a 126 px rounded-square avatar with a 5 px blue border and flat-colour character illustration, a bold blue sans name (Daniel, Alex...), and on the chosen row a blue outlined check circle at the right. Collapsed state (rest 0.9-3.45 s): roll 758-1262 x 316-790, two rows, Daniel then Alex with a check. Motion: 0.15-0.85 s the paper prints down from the roll, overshooting its bottom edge to ~860 at 0.5 s and settling back to ~785, while rows ride down with it. A cursor comes in from bottom-left and clicks Alex. 3.5-4.45 s the whole roll shrinks to a narrow tall receipt (832-1160 x, top 118) that unrolls off the bottom of the frame, now listing Mia, Marcus, Leo, Emma, Daniel, Alex at a ~152 px row pitch with 80 px avatars. The hovered row (Emma) gets a pale lavender (#e8e9f8) band. 5.35-7.0 s the list scrolls inside the paper to show Ethan, Oliver, James at the top, then scrolls back so Lucas and Noah show below Alex. At ~8.05 s clicking Emma moves the check to Emma and tears the receipt along a zig-zag line just under Emma's row. 8.1-9.55 s the lower piece (Daniel, Alex, Lucas, Noah) drops out of the bottom of the frame while the upper part retracts back into the wide collapsed roll, which then rests (9.7-10.65 s) showing Leo then Emma with the check. 10.7-11.65 s it expands again into the narrow receipt, which now ends at Emma (check) with a torn edge, listing Oliver, James, Mia, Marcus, Leo, Emma.

criteria.check: Background is a flat very light grey-lilac (~#f6f6f9) with no gradient, texture, or shadow
A small grey rounded pill ~52x10 px sits centred at the bottom edge (x≈954-1006, y≈1060)
Collapsed roll spans roughly x 758-1262 and y 316-790, horizontally centred near x 1010
Roll is drawn with a thick (~8-12px) saturated royal-blue (#2826c8) outline, paper fill near-white
Upper part of the sides bulge outward like a cylinder (thicker curved strokes) down to ~y 640, then straight paper continues below
Bottom edge of the paper is an irregular zig-zag torn line, not straight or rounded
A 3D box-shaped bracket drawn in blue outline (front face with an inner tall rectangle, visible top and side faces) attaches to the roll's left side at x≈672-748, y≈412-556
A small narrow outlined tab (~16x76 px) sticks out of the roll's right side at x≈1272-1288, y≈450-526
Upper row reads exactly "Daniel" in bold blue sans, ~38px cap-to-baseline, left edge at x≈955
Lower row reads exactly "Alex" in the same bold blue, left edge at x≈955, y centre ≈674
Avatar is a rounded square (~126px, ~22px radius) with a ~5px blue border
Daniel avatar is an original flat drawing of a man in a red shirt on a lime-green (#c4fe43) background, not copied pixels
Alex avatar is an original flat drawing of a dark-haired man with glasses, white collar and dark tie on a violet (#a18bf9) background
Alex row has a blue outlined circle (~52px) with a blue tick inside, unfilled, right-aligned at x≈1172-1224
Only one row (Alex) shows a check; Daniel row has none
Rows are separated by horizontal lavender dashed lines (~2px, ~12px dashes) spanning the paper width, at y≈349 and y≈561
A sliver of a third row's avatar (coral, Emma) is cut off at the top edge of the roll, implying content continues upward into the roll
During the intro the paper extends downward: bottom edge is at y≈860 at 0.5s and settles back up to y≈785 by 1.0s (overshoot ~75px then return)
Rows ride down with the paper during the intro: Daniel avatar top is at y≈440 at 0.5s and y≈380 at 1.0s
Nothing moves between 1.0s and 2.2s except the cursor; roll, rows and check stay put
Cursor moves from bottom-left of the roll (≈680,810 at 2.2s) up onto the Alex label by 2.7s and turns into a hand pointer
Over a row the cursor is a white pointing-hand with black outline, ~40px
Between 3.5s and 4.45s the roll narrows from ~504px to ~320px wide and its top rises from y≈316 to y≈120 while the paper lengthens down past the frame bottom
Expanded receipt spans x≈835-1158 with top at y≈118; the bracket sits at x≈780-830, y≈187-276
Expanded list at 5.1s reads top to bottom: "Mia", "Marcus", "Leo", "Emma", "Daniel", "Alex"
Rows in the expanded state are spaced at ~152px pitch (name centres ≈159, 306, 459, 611, 763, 914)
In the expanded state avatars shrink to ~80px rounded squares with the same blue border, left edge at x≈863
At 5.1s the receipt's torn bottom edge is visible at y≈985 with Alex (check) as the last row
The hovered Emma row is filled with a pale lavender (#e8e9f8) band spanning the full paper width between its two dividers
Rows not under the cursor have no lavender fill
Each name has its own distinct original flat character avatar: Mia (coral bg, dark hair), Marcus (coral bg, blue hoodie), Leo (blue bg, red cap), Emma (coral bg, blonde girl)
Between 5.5s and 6.38s the list scrolls inside the receipt: content moves down so new rows "Ethan", "Oliver", "James" appear at the top while the receipt outline stays fixed
At 6.38s list reads top to bottom: "Ethan", "Oliver", "James", "Mia", "Marcus", "Leo", "Emma"
At 7.6s list reads: "Marcus", "Leo", "Emma", "Daniel", "Alex", "Lucas", "Noah" (Lucas and Noah follow Alex)
Lucas avatar is a man in red on a green background; Noah avatar is a boy with green cap on a purple/pink background; both original flat drawings
Clicking Emma (~8.0s) puts the check circle on the Emma row at x≈1100-1132 and Alex no longer has it
At 8.1s a blue zig-zag tear line cuts across the receipt directly under the Emma row (y≈505-520)
After the tear the lower piece (Daniel, Alex, Lucas, Noah) slides down out of frame; by 8.82s only its torn top edge shows at y≈1030-1080
Between 8.1s and 9.7s the upper part retracts into the wide collapsed roll and returns to centre (x≈758-1262, y≈316-790)
At rest at 10.2s the collapsed roll shows "Leo" on top and "Emma" below with the check circle on Emma
Between 10.2s and 10.7s the collapsed roll does not change size or position (only the cursor moves)
Between 10.7s and 11.65s the roll expands again into the narrow tall receipt with top near y≈120
Final expanded list reads "Oliver", "James", "Mia", "Marcus", "Leo", "Emma" and ends at Emma (check) with a torn bottom edge; Daniel/Alex/Lucas/Noah are gone
The left bracket and right tab travel with the roll top: they move from y≈412-556 (collapsed) to y≈187-276 (expanded) and scale down with it
No drop shadows anywhere: roll, avatars and band are flat outline-and-fill drawing
Name text colour is the same royal blue as the outlines (~#2826c8), not black
